svg.title: Navier–Stokes v1.1.0 · Figure 6 · The Bit Delivered Twice: Two Kinds And No Third
svg.text: FIGURE 6
THE BIT DELIVERED TWICE: TWO KINDS AND NO THIRD
NAVIER–STOKES · FORM BY THEOREM, VALUE BY THE ACT · MASTER v1.1.0_CC · EVERY NAME CHECKED
STEP 10 · THE BIT DELIVERED TWICE, BY ITS TWO KINDS, AND NO THIRD
KIND 1 · THE FORMAL CARGO
The record's value carried to the host's frame. It arrives free, the
antecedent a theorem; it gives global regularity in one step; and it is
exactly the sentence.

svg.text: KIND 2 · THE PHYSICAL WITNESS
Matter read through the quantum speed limit and the cascade: every
stage count before a horizon T is at most c · E · T, and an unbounded
count needs stage counts above every bound. The last two fields are the
bit read in the register of registrations, carried as fields, never proved.

svg.text: The two kinds are one bit
The physical witness is a formal cargo, and the
cargo is exactly the sentence.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Two kinds and no third
Every witness of the sentence, in any vocabulary, is
a delivery of both kinds.

svg.text: The one refuter
One blowup refutes both kinds at once, and the
sentence itself.

svg.text: THE WITNESSES OF THE SUBJECT, TYPED · EACH SHORT OF THE BIT, INSIDE IT, OR LOAD-BEARING
The energy inequality
It holds on a blowup frame: the energy record
decides nothing.

tspan.font-family: RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
RowMono, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The small-data theorem
It gives the real part on every frame that carries it
and stops short of the value.

svg.text: The speed limit and the cascade
Each load-bearing; on every physical frame no
datum blows up and matter is regular.
